Dear Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0430445 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Please note that during the analysis of the charger and error flags, it was observed that the LEM is experiencing an issue. Among the LEM error flags, the error flag detected is "
muFatalErrorOccured":true
." This indicates that
Errors correspond to protective behavior against malfunction, data corruption and data loss. In case below suggestions are not sufficient, it means that the DCBM reached a protective lock state. In this case the product is no longer usable and must be replaced.
Outlet 1: outoforder, MeterState: Error Error on LEM DC Meter (meter id: 1222441931 status: {"value":19,"bits":{"suLinkStatusIsOk":true,"muFatalErrorOccured":true,"transactionIsOnGoing":false,"tamperingIsDetected":false,"timeSyncStatusIsOk":true,"overTemperatureIsDetected":false,"reversedVoltage":false,"suMeasureFailureOccurred":false}}, error: {"value":16,"bits":{"muInitIsFailed":false,"suStateIsInvalid":false,"versionCheckIsFailed":false,"muRngInitIsFailed":false,"muDataIntegrityIsFailed":true,"muFwIntegrityIsFailed":false,"suIntegrityIsFailed":false,"logbookIntegrityIsFailed":false,"logbookIsFull":false,"memoryAccessIsFailed":false,"muStateIsFailed":false}})
Before proceeding, please verify the current LEM rating as the charger configuration is not linked to the SCB, and the faulty outlet has a rating of 400A. Consequently, place the order based on the highlighted part numbers, considering that the charger is non-ERK.
